# CPU environment of the assembly (mode `assemble`): tools/make_submission.py, the build scripts under tools/builds/, the step
# scripts under eda/ that the build scripts call, and the tests.
# Python: 3.13.5 (CPython, Linux x86_64, glibc 2.39).
# CUDA: not used. Everything runs on the CPU with two BLAS threads (OPENBLAS_NUM_THREADS=2 OMP_NUM_THREADS=2). torch and
#   transformers are only imported by shared model helpers; the reference machine had the default PyPI build of torch 2.11.0
#   (built for CUDA 13.0, therefore the cuda-* and nvidia-* pins below), used on the CPU only. The CPU build of torch 2.11.0
#   (https://download.pytorch.org/whl/cpu, without the cuda-* and nvidia-* lines) gave the same results on 2026-11-21: quick
#   check, full proof and tests (docs/VERIFICATION.md, section 2).
# Pins: the packages and versions that the build files import, their dependencies, and what the imports load besides,
#   as installed in the reference build environment (import probe of the assembly).
#   python -m pip install -r env/requirements-cpu.txt
